title: Broncos WR/KR Marvin Mims Jr. is going to be fine and is dealing with a bruised foot

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos WR/KR Marvin Mims Jr. is going to be fine and is dealing with a bruised foot
sources.description: Broncos All-Pro kick returner and big-play specialist Marvin Mims Jr. received his first preseason action of the summer last night. Unfortunately, his night would not last long after he suffered an apparent lower-body injury in the opening series. He was down in pain for a bit before jogging off the field.
